dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, jagged 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity rings with high-contrast dark perimeters. Gradient transitions are sharp, moving from dark exterior edges to mottled light-grey interiors, most prominent in the central dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters localized within the interior of the ring structures and distributed along the dorsal-lateral midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal ring structures form an irregular trapezoidal geometry, where the anterior pair exhibits a narrower horizontal distance than the posterior pair.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive overlapping network of ring-like patterns creating a complex, interconnected lace-like texture across the visible dorsal-lateral surface.
